messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete VoiceStudio as a single-file HTML site with 12 free, locally running voice tools.
- Add Kannada (ಕನ್ನಡ) support throughout the tools, including voice selection, text input, speech recognition, dubbing, and keyboard assistance.

## Requirements
- Mobile-first design with rounded white cards, green accent `#309D4B`, and horizontally scrollable mobile navigation.
- Use built-in browser APIs; external scripts may come only from `cdnjs.cloudflare.com`. No sign-up or paid APIs.
- Reload voices on `voiceschanged`; provide friendly API errors and note voices depend on the browser and device.
- Voice Cloning links to `https://play.cartesia.ai`.
- Preserve existing local audio processing and clarify its limitations: Text to MP3 records microphone audio while speech synthesis plays through speakers; Speech to Text requires on-device recognition; Voice Changer and Voice Conversion are local approximations, not AI conversion.
- Add `Kannada (ಕನ್ನಡ) - kn-IN` as the first option in every language dropdown; filter voices by language starting with `kn` and select a `kn-IN` voice when Kannada is chosen.
- If no Kannada voice is found, show: `Kannada voice not installed. On Android: Settings > Language > Text-to-speech > Google > Install voice data > Kannada. On Windows: Settings > Time & Language > Speech > Add voices > Kannada.`
- Set the Text to Speech and AI Voice Generator textareas to `lang="kn"` and use Noto Sans Kannada; add the four specified Kannada sample chips.
- Add Kannada speech recognition (`recognition.lang = "kn-IN"`), a Kannada typing/mic option, and a Copy button.
- Allow Kannada voice selection per AI Voiceover scene; add an English → Kannada dubbing option for pasted translated text.
- Support Kannada text and downloads in Text to MP3.
- Add a Kannada Keyboard helper with the specified common-letter buttons and an insertion target, plus the hint: `Type in English letters, then use Google Input Tools (free) to convert.`
- Keep the page UI in English and Kannada; tools remain free and use Web Speech API.

## Decisions
- Text to MP3 captures speech through the microphone because browsers do not expose speechSynthesis audio directly; warn that headphones may not be captured.
- Speech-to-Text requires on-device recognition support.
- Voice Changer and Voice Conversion use local pitch/filter approximations and clarify that real AI conversion requires a model.
- Voice Cloning is linked to Cartesia Playground and does not clone locally.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing `index.html` implements the 12-tool VoiceStudio site, navigation, inline CSS/JS, voice loading, speech synthesis, audio processing/recording, and required disclaimers.
- Wired Realistic Text to Speech speed and pitch controls; fixed AI Voice Enhancer Before/After playback.
- Extracted inline JavaScript and verified syntax with `node --check`.
- Previous request to return the complete file remains unfinished; prior response was truncated and only a partial continuation was provided.

### Active
- Implement Kannada support throughout `index.html`, including language selectors, Kannada voice detection and guidance, textareas and sample chips, recognition, voiceover, dubbing, MP3, keyboard helper, and transliteration hint.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect and update `index.html` to implement the Kannada requirements across all applicable tools.
2. Run JavaScript syntax validation and verify the language/voice selection behavior.
3. Return the completed file as requested, without explanations.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file VoiceStudio implementation to update.

- Changes are uncommitted; `index.html` is untracked. Other untracked files include `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh`.
- No Kannada changes have been made yet.

PURPOSE
Turn a script into a vertical (9:16, 1080x1920) or horizontal (16:9) video with voiceover, text, and visuals. Everything runs locally, with no sign-up and no paid API.


INPUTS
1. Script box: split into scenes by blank lines (max 10 scenes).
2. Language and voice per project, including Kannada (kn-IN) and English.
3. Aspect ratio selector: 9:16, 16:9, 1:1.
4. Style presets: Clean White, Dark Neon, Gradient, Minimal Black.
5. Per-scene options:
   - Upload an image or video clip as background (optional)
   - Pick an animation: Fade, Slide Up, Zoom, Typewriter
   - Scene duration: Auto (matches the voice length) or a manual slider
6. Background music: upload an mp3, with a volume slider.
7. Subtitles toggle: show the scene text as captions with a font size slider. Use Noto Sans Kannada for Kannada text.


ENGINE
- Draw each scene on a <canvas> with requestAnimationFrame (background, animated text, captions).
- Voiceover: speechSynthesis reads each scene. Use utterance events (onstart/onend) to time each scene so visuals and voice stay in sync.
- Recording: combine canvas.captureStream(30) with an audio track and record with MediaRecorder as WebM. For audio, use the Web Audio API (uploaded music) and offer a "Share tab audio" option via getDisplayMedia so the voiceover is captured. Show a clear instruction: "Choose this tab and tick Share tab audio."
- Preview button: play the video live before recording.
- Download button: save as .webm. Add a note on converting to MP4 with a free converter.
- Progress bar and a Cancel button during recording.


UI
- Matches the existing VoiceStudio style (green accent #309D4B, mobile-first).
- Scene cards list with drag-to-reorder or Up/Down buttons.
- Live canvas preview at the top.


RULES
- Only free, built-in browser APIs (Canvas, speechSynthesis, MediaRecorder, Web Audio). Scripts only from cdnjs.cloudflare.com.
- Try/catch everywhere, with friendly messages (for example, "Please use Chrome on desktop for recording").
- No data is uploaded anywhere.
- Add a note: "Browser voices may sound robotic. For a natural voice, import an audio file made with Cartesia or another TTS and use it as the voiceover track."
- Add an "Import voiceover audio" option: upload an mp3 and spread the scenes across its total length, which gives better sync and quality.


OUTPUT

- Preserve the mobile-first design, green `#309D4B` accent, rounded cards, and horizontally scrollable navigation.

## Objective
- Complete VoiceStudio as a single-file HTML site with 13 free, locally running voice tools, including Kannada support and an AI Video Creator.
- Validate and refine the implementation, then provide the updated `index.html`.

## Requirements
- Preserve the mobile-first design, green `#309D4B` accent, rounded cards, and horizontally scrollable navigation.
- Keep processing local and use free browser APIs; external scripts may come only from `cdnjs.cloudflare.com`.
- AI Video Creator: up to 10 blank-line-separated scenes; Kannada and English voice selection; 9:16, 16:9, and 1:1 ratios; four style presets; per-scene media, animation, and auto/manual duration; MP3 music and volume; subtitles and font-size control; canvas preview; scene reordering; WebM recording, progress, and cancellation.
- Support imported voiceover audio spread across scenes; explain tab-audio sharing, desktop Chrome recording, local processing, robotic browser voices, and free MP4 conversion.
- Continue supporting the existing 12 tools and prior Kannada voice, typing, recognition, and dubbing requirements.

## Decisions
- For synthesized voice recordings, use `getDisplayMedia` tab audio because speech synthesis does not expose an audio stream; ask the user to choose this tab and tick “Share tab audio.”
- Imported voiceover and music use Web Audio; combine canvas and audio tracks for WebM recording.
- Reuse persistent Web Audio media-element sources and route monitoring/recording audio separately to support repeated recordings and avoid duplicating music in tab audio.
- Music volume is applied on the audio element, while Web Audio gain nodes separately control monitoring and recording.
- For imported voiceover timing, keep manual scene durations fixed and distribute remaining audio time across auto scenes; if all scenes are manual, add any remaining voiceover time to the last scene.
- Kannada voice availability depends on installed browser/device voices; Voice Conversion and Voice Changer remain local approximations, and dubbing does not provide automatic translation or video export.
